purpose: Provide a fail-closed deployment-side collector that can bind exact ClayVerse image digest, Kubernetes RuntimeClass/handler, host-versus-guest kernel identity, container security boundary and the complete NetworkPolicy set selecting the ClayVerse pod without fabricating CNI enforcement or whole-product acceptance.
authority_fences: declarative NetworkPolicy presence never sets enforcement_observed=true
an active deny/allow probe remains required
no second ClayVerse state, identity, effect or retrieval authority is introduced
collector is deployment evidence tooling, not a companion application container
fail_closed_checks: exact sha256 image digest in pod spec and runtime imageID
exact expected RuntimeClass and non-empty handler
guest kernel non-empty and distinguishable from node host kernel
enumerate every NetworkPolicy selecting the pod
exact clayverse-default-deny present for Ingress+Egress with empty rules
reject obvious broad selecting policy forms including empty allow rules and global 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ipBlocks
hash canonical projection of the complete selecting NetworkPolicy inventory
negative_results_preserved: initial test collection failed because the dynamic import did not register the dataclass module in sys.modules; repaired as a test-loader defect

second run reached 7/8 PASS and exposed only an over-specific expected error regex; the collector correctly failed earlier on no selecting NetworkPolicy; test expectation repaired without weakening the collector
primary_source_alignment: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy selection is additive and depends on an enforcing network plugin/CNI
Kata RuntimeClass plus guest uname evidence is a bounded runtime identity discriminator, not whole-product proof
next_gate: Run this exact collector against the exact accepted ClayVerse OCI digest under the admitted Kata/equivalent target, then separately execute active default-deny and reviewed-allow network probes plus the broader MicroVM recovery/concurrency acceptance matrix.
